$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
SOURCE='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png'
OLD='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_45_step05.png'
test -f "$SOURCE" && test -f "$OLD"
test "$(sha256sum "$SOURCE" | awk '{print $1}')" = '429c0a45293e64de09f8da94e795c088e53afbd023337af3a59e344776412c2d'
test "$(sha256sum "$OLD" | awk '{print $1}')" = '9ade1c59b48221ad3c266fe50151c8efe35655b3fddaa197cf8b61d2a2030684'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry-ccw-venv
/tmp/fishfry-ccw-venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry-ccw-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from PIL import Image, ImageChops
root=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry')
src=root/'pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png'
old=root/'pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_45_step05.png'
out1=root/'pizza_screen_rotations_minus05_to_plus45_step05.png'
out2=root/'pizza_screen_rotations_minus10_to_plus45_step05.png'
assert not out1.exists() and not out2.exists(), 'Output already exists; refusing overwrite'
with Image.open(src) as source, Image.open(old) as existing:
 original=source.convert('RGB')
 nine=existing.convert('RGB')
 W,H=original.size
 assert (W,H)==(1536,1476),(W,H)
 assert nine.size==(10*W,H),nine.size
 assert ImageChops.difference(nine.crop((0,0,W,H)),original).getbbox() is None,'Existing first frame not identical to original'
 ccw5=original.rotate(5,resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC,expand=False,fillcolor='white')
 eleven=Image.new('RGB',(11*W,H),'white')
 eleven.paste(ccw5,(0,0))
 eleven.paste(nine,(W,0))
 eleven.save(out1,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
 assert ImageChops.difference(eleven.crop((W,0,eleven.width,H)),nine).getbbox() is None
 print('SAVED_ITERATION_1',str(out1),eleven.size,'BYTES',out1.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(out1.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
 ccw10=ccw5.rotate(5,resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC,expand=False,fillcolor='white')
 twelve=Image.new('RGB',(12*W,H),'white')
 twelve.paste(ccw10,(0,0))
 twelve.paste(eleven,(W,0))
 twelve.save(out2,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
 assert ImageChops.difference(twelve.crop((W,0,twelve.width,H)),eleven).getbbox() is None
 print('SAVED_ITERATION_2',str(out2),twelve.size,'BYTES',out2.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(out2.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
PY
git add -- terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_minus05_to_plus45_step05.png terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_minus10_to_plus45_step05.png

git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Append two five-degree counterclockwise rotations to left of fish-fry strip'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
  git fetch --quiet origin main
  git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
  if git push origin HEAD:main; then
    printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
    for path in terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_minus05_to_plus45_step05.png terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_minus10_to_plus45_step05.png; do
      gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$path" --jq '[.path,.size,.sha] | @tsv'
      printf 'LOCAL_BLOB '; git hash-object "$path"
    done
    exit 0
  fi
done
echo 'PUBLISH_FAILED_AFTER_RETRIES' >&2
exit 1
